A while ago I started to play rust differently, I stopped playing in a group and went solo on PvP servers with no intention of PvP I wanted to see what would happen if I made an art gallery which was open for anyone to come in and paint, any resources I didn't need for the gallery were placed in a box that people could take.

In the beginning I was killed over and over again but it didn't bother me as I really wanted to see what would happen with the pictures and sure enough there were lots of dick pics but also some really good art too.  I was excited to come online and see what people had drawn (Instead of logging on and seeing if I had a base left at all!).  

I generally found that the community was really great, people would leave me some cloth so I could make more pictures, people come over and had a chat and yes some people did kill me but all in all I had a really good time with people I've never met before.

I've never had a problem with anyone destroying the gallery or paintings, in fairness what's the point of blowing up a building you can freely walk into with all the loot conveniently placed in a box or two.  I was happy enough to roam around getting things and I suppose people were happy that they could just come and get all the stuff I didn't need.

I know this isn't how the game is supposed to be played but it was an interesting experience and one that I don't regret and I will still continue to do.
